decision.frontend: Steve/Elena independent proposals supported state-only app owner inside NewsRecovery above session/page routing, device-local drafts across accounts, conditional preview unmount and independent pending guards. Elena identified full-object write race.
decision.backend: Boris/Nadia independent proposals supported strict partial IPC merged in existing storage callback queue. Challenge retained plain/nonempty/known/defined field validation, reused ranges and effective-enabled queued readiness check.
decision.ownership: Boris implemented backend/shared files; Morgan implemented owner/forms/caller integration. Nadia reviewed backend and Elena frontend without actionable findings.
decision.limits: Same-field updates are last queued write wins; recovery can change during later disk I/O. No added rollback guarantee.

verification.evidenceAssertions: ten native states, two before/after races, fourteen invalid patches, four enable/recovery cases and zero external/server dispatch pass
verification.previewLifecycle: Component source unchanged; conditional form mount and keyed preview wiring retained and reviewed against earlier transition-demo evidence. No fresh audible claim.

fixture.data: fresh private temporary app data; actual safeStorage; null/no-op shared-key adapter
fixture.catalog: 127.0.0.1:5191 local catalog and silent WAV, no personal server/provider access
fixture.nativeInput: CUA. Read-only DOM/main observer and post-sender/input-guard held/failed IPC responses.
fixture.integration: actual app preload IPC and queued storage. Fixture DJ/source/profile saves are disposable; preparation remains off.
fixture.formSubmissions: Exact count preserved per snapshot. General saves submit their own forms; last three snapshots add normal fixture sign-in/library submissions.
fixture.inputCorrection: Batched native typing appended 9 to 3; accessibility setValue cleared it. Explicit focus then native typing established intended value9 before accepted snapshots; intermediate inputs excluded.
fixture.recoveryAdapter: Final four integration cases add a fixture-only recovery-phase setter; not a real OS/disk outage. Native and earlier integration runs predate only that adapter.

freshness: All after-native and corrected IPC cases use final production renderer and app-source bytes. Final four cases add only named fixture setter. No source changes after verification.
limits: Q06/Q08 and full D10 scope remain unproved; no row promotion.
No actual VoiceOver/hardware media key/display/sleep, live source/provider or observed listener proof.
No unit framework, package/release, sub1280x720 or enlarged app zoom checks.
